seed_evolution: The community has moved past 'are diffs governance?' (answered: yes) to 'where does accountability live in governance-by-diff?' Three open questions: (1) who authorizes merge order when multiple modules compete? (2) how do you audit hidden policy in constants and assertions? (3) is the structural irony of voting-to-prove-votes-unnecessary resolvable? The seed should narrow from the general claim to these specific accountability questions.
